europe_now.title: Severe Civil Unrest and Arson Sweeps Across France
europe_now.summary: Nationwide demonstrations in France have deteriorated into violent clashes, widespread looting, and major structural fires resulting in over a thousand arrests. Law enforcement and protesters engaged in intense confrontations as demonstrators mobilized against austerity measures and worsening living conditions.

europe_now.title: Pope Leo Discharged Following Lung Cancer Surgery
europe_now.summary: Pope Leo has returned to the Vatican just days after undergoing successful lung cancer surgery. Medical teams confirmed his recovery progress, allowing the pontiff to be discharged from the hospital.

top_stories.title: Escalating Energy Threats in Ukraine
top_stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that Russian authorities are actively targeting the nation's infrastructure to cause widespread blackouts ahead of the winter season. The developments coincide with ongoing strategic concerns regarding foreign policy shifts and regional energy security.

top_stories.title: Expansion of Municipal Tourism Regulations in Poland
top_stories.summary: Polish legislative measures are moving forward to grant additional local municipalities the authority to implement tourist fees. The regulatory changes aim to help regional authorities manage visitor numbers and local infrastructure costs.
